# Correcting a processed payroll after an approved contract change

Use this procedure when an approved contract change was not reflected in a processed payroll.

1. The consultant documents the approved change and the processed value, with references.
2. The payroll lead reviews and approves the correction. The person who proposes a correction does not approve it.
3. The correction is calculated in the next payroll run or as a separate calculation, as agreed with the client.
4. The consultant informs the client contact and records the outcome on the case.
